description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Demonic Gifts triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.
